A1.justification: Both 12-page PDFs describe the same DOVE study and provide readable methods, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither includes an appendix. Separately referenced supplementary material is outside the supplied evidence.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, training and dataset ablations, qualitative comparisons, and inference-time measurements in Tables 1–3 and Figures 1, 4, and 5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative comparisons, and inference-time measurements.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same CogVideoX-based one-step procedure, timestep 399, latent-pixel training stages, losses, frame-wise VAE processing, and dataset-curation pipeline.

E1.justification: Both use HQ-VSR and DIV2K for training, the same YouHQ/OpenVid-1M dataset ablations, and six evaluation datasets: UDM10, SPMCS, YouHQ40, RealVSR, MVSR4x, and VideoLQ. Task coverage remains unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains RealESRGAN, ResShift, RealBasicVSR, Upscale-A-Video, MGLD-VSR, VEnhancer, and STAR. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the runtime and visual comparisons; citation renumbering does not replace methods.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same degradations, ×4 scaling, metrics, training configurations, and 10,000-plus-500-iteration schedule. Runtime comparisons still use a 33-frame 720×1280 video on an A100. The new introductory 10K statement does not revise these detailed settings.

E4.justification: The training-stage, image-ratio, training-dataset, and processing-pipeline ablations in Table 1 are unchanged, as is the temporal-consistency analysis. Corrected pipeline-step references in the caption align with the existing descriptions rather than introducing a different ablation.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same results and rankings. VEnhancer's VideoLQ warping error changes from 6.50 to 6.495, an equivalent rounding difference. Figure images are unchanged. The new pointer to supplementary comparisons supplies no additional result entries within v2.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8), their mathematical definitions, and associated reasoning remain unchanged. Neither version includes additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: v2 adds an explicit introductory claim that model fine-tuning finishes 'within only 10K iterations.' The central one-step novelty, training strategy, HQ-VSR contribution, performance claims, and 28× inference-speed claim remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Explanations of timestep selection, latent-space reconstruction errors, mixed image/video training, motion filtering, and temporal consistency are retained. No substantive applicability boundary, failure condition, or limitation is added.

D1.justification: The implementation disclosures retain the same backbone, empty prompt, GPUs, batch size, optimizer parameters, learning rates, resolutions, frame length, and loss weights. The code-access URL and data-processing instructions are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 removes the BasicVSR++ and VideoCrafter2 references and shortens descriptions of several retained works, including DBVSR, FastRealVSR, MGLD-VSR, STAR, SinSR, and TSD-SR. The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized introductory edits, condenses related work, updates affiliations and the conference-status footer, and adds a supplementary-results pointer. The section organization and most scientific prose remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1's caption corrects filtering/motion references from steps 2–4/5 to 1–3/4. Figure 4 changes the YouHQ40 identifier from 023 to 036 while retaining identical images. Minor page reflow occurs; all five figures and three tables remain.

improvement.justification: The method and empirical support remain unchanged. Correcting Table 1 improves local clarity, but the new 'within only 10K iterations' claim conflicts with the retained 10,000-plus-500 schedule in Section 4.1. These limited corrections and editorial tradeoffs leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
